milestone: R3.10 Windows and Linux Canvas round-trip repair
status: Terminal failed on exact SHA 3d16c073fe276c1e32b91d868da73b26ad7acb17: 7/7 workflows terminal (6 passed, 1 failed); 20/20 jobs terminal (19 passed, 1 failed). Linux round-trip failed before clipboard staging; Windows and macOS round-trip jobs passed. All 16 API artifact records and all three round-trip archive/report hashes are reconciled. R3.10 is not achieved because the required Linux round-trip job failed.
objective: Repair the two terminal R3.9 round-trip failures as one complete milestone: preserve exact Windows Canvas recovery-manifest and process-close acceptance while accounting for Windows canonical path spelling; keep the Linux expected-abort canary from creating app-owned eframe persistence while preserving strict full app-data equality and all canary safety checks.

windows.error: Canvas write transaction recovery manifest did not match the exact writer schema and pre/post Canvas state.
windows.root_cause: The report does not expose raw manifest values or field-level flags. Static source inspection shows Rust serializes a canonicalized PathBuf with to_string_lossy(), while the harness uses raw string equality for manifest.path and already normalizes Windows canonical paths for confinement. A Windows extended-length prefix or equivalent spelling difference is plausible but remains unconfirmed.

linux.finding: The expected-abort guard was the sole failed predicate; there was no pointer motion, Ctrl+V, completed paste, or save; cleanup, process exit, vault and Canvas preservation passed. Strict app-data equality failed because shutdown created data/openobsidian/app.ron (2631 bytes; SHA-256 df5fb43653f671f2b37af7806a4fc6823273bcb8e482fc86719e42b8687818bb).
linux.source_candidate: The existing OPENOBSIDIAN_CI_CANVAS_DISABLE_EFRAME_PERSISTENCE flag disables both persisted egui memory and window state and emits a runtime marker. Scope that existing flag to the Linux expected-abort child and keep strict equality.
linux.warmup_baseline: The R3.9 report contains no data/openobsidian/app.ron in the stabilized prelaunch snapshot or any earlier phase inspection; the only app.ron appeared in the post-termination snapshot.

included: Windows Canvas transaction recovery manifest and state acceptance: compare the serialized canonical artifact path using the existing Windows path normalizer, retain exact schema/revision/byte checks, canonical root confinement, regular-file checks, unchanged pre-save state, and accepted post-save/process-close equality; include failed-field diagnostics without dumping path values.

Linux expected-abort canary: disable eframe persistence only for that child using the existing environment flag, require the Rust runtime policy marker, and retain exact full-root app-data equality with no allowlist or shifted snapshot boundary.
Keep ordinary Linux Canvas workflow persistence behavior unchanged; preserve the existing Windows persistence profile and all macOS acceptance.
Reconcile all 16 GitHub API artifact metadata records, plus the three round-trip archive/API digests, report hashes, report source SHAs, and exact-SHA workflow results in tracker evidence.
excluded: The separate dirty root checkout C07.3/C07.5/C09.2 changes and stale evidence; do not transplant or merge them.
Unrelated Bases, appearance, plugin, or vault migration work.
Allowlisting app.ron, weakening manifest/schema/revision/hash checks, moving preservation snapshots after shutdown, or relaxing canary guards.

acceptance: A whole-source and tracker review approves the complete R3.10 milestone before its single push.
All seven required GitHub Actions workflows and all 20 required jobs pass for the exact R3.10 SHA.

Windows Canvas write transaction has exactly the expected prepared/committed journal entries, exact recovery bytes and manifests, confined regular files, unchanged pre-save state, and process-close state equal to the accepted post-save snapshot.

Linux expected-abort canary proves the synthetic target-value mismatch is its sole failed predicate; it dispatches no pointer motion, Ctrl+V, completed paste, or save; cleanup and process exit succeed; vault and full app-data snapshots remain identical, with no new app.ron.
The eframe persistence opt-out is scoped only to the Linux expected-abort canary and its runtime marker is present; normal Linux and macOS workflows retain their established policies.
All 16 GitHub API artifact metadata records, plus the three round-trip archive/API digests and report source SHAs, are reconciled.
validation_policy: GitHub Actions only. Do not run local tests, builds, formatters, linters, validators, runtime probes, or application launches. Keep all work local until the named milestone is complete and reviewed; push once, then hold origin/main at its submitted SHA until all jobs and artifacts are reconciled.

changes: Compare Windows recovery manifest paths through the existing Windows canonical-path normalizer while retaining exact manifest schema, revision, size, hash, journal, confinement, and process-close checks.
Report failed manifest field labels only; reject non-object JSON roots with a schema_root label.

Enable the existing full eframe-persistence opt-out only for the Linux expected-abort child after standard warm-up and prelaunch inspection; require its runtime marker and keep complete app-data snapshot equality.
Keep ordinary Linux, Windows, and macOS persistence behavior unchanged outside the named Linux canary scope.

linux_roundtrip_report.failure_cause: Unconfirmed; the expected-abort persistence change is explicitly disabled for the normal Linux text-edit child.
